name: Stencil Clip Mask Generation
definition: Generates a stencil buffer mask for UI clipping by applying a sequence of stencil operations based on the requested ClipMaskOperation (Set, SetInverse, Intersect).
summary: Stencil Clip Mask Generation creates stencil buffer masks for UI clipping, distinguishing itself by enabling arbitrary closed surface geometries to define clipping regions rather than relying on standard depth-based methods.
